purpose: Define event-conditioned opportunity denominators before inspecting the expansion sample, so positive events cannot determine their own denominator after the fact.

two_pass_annotation.pass_a: Identify every qualifying INITIATIVE_ATTACK opportunity anchor without using candidate-model output, odds, finish order, payout, or prediction performance.
two_pass_annotation.pass_b: For each frozen attack anchor, label the linked BANTE_FOLLOW and INITIATIVE_CONFLICT opportunities using the fixed windows below.
two_pass_annotation.reason: The attack anchor defines the eligible denominator; downstream labels cannot create or delete their own opportunities.

qualifying_attack_anchor.definition: A visually observable line leader or solo rider makes a sustained forward move intended to take or materially challenge the occupied forward race position, visible across at least two ordered observations or one continuous segment if later reviewed in video.
exclude: mere wheel overlap with no sustained forward movement
final sprint/overtake after the field has entered the terminal sprint phase
camera cut or occlusion that prevents actor continuity
movement inferred only from commentary without visual support
qualifying_attack_anchor.anchor_timestamp: First clearly observable frame/instant of the sustained forward move.
qualifying_attack_anchor.actor_requirement: Car number when visually identifiable; otherwise UNKNOWN_ACTOR and the anchor remains unusable for BANTE_FOLLOW if the expected direct follower cannot be identified.

bante_follow_opportunity.eligibility: A qualifying attack anchor by a rider who has an identifiable direct expected follower immediately before the attack.
bante_follow_opportunity.present: Within 6 seconds of the attack anchor, the direct expected follower visibly maintains or re-establishes immediate attachment behind the attacking leader without an intervening rival occupying that direct following position for the remainder of the observable window.
bante_follow_opportunity.absent: The direct expected follower is clearly observable and fails to maintain/re-establish the direct following position within 6 seconds while another rider or a visible gap separates the pair.
bante_follow_opportunity.unknown: Follower identity, continuity, or the relevant 6-second window is not sufficiently visible to distinguish PRESENT from ABSENT.
bante_follow_opportunity.denominator: Only PRESENT plus ABSENT opportunities. UNKNOWN is reported separately and excluded from the numeric denominator.

initiative_conflict_opportunity.eligibility: A qualifying attack anchor where the forward path reaches an already occupied/defended forward position during the 6-second window.
initiative_conflict_opportunity.present: Within 6 seconds, the attacker and incumbent are visibly side-by-side, resisting, overlapping longitudinally with active position contest, or the incumbent visibly holds/defends while the attacker continues the challenge.
initiative_conflict_opportunity.absent: The attacker reaches the occupied forward position and passes/takes it without a visually sustained contest meeting the PRESENT definition.
initiative_conflict_opportunity.unknown: Camera angle, occlusion, or identity continuity prevents a confident PRESENT/ABSENT distinction.
initiative_conflict_opportunity.denominator: Only PRESENT plus ABSENT eligible opportunities. UNKNOWN is reported separately and excluded from the numeric denominator.

phase_rule.terminal_sprint_exclusion: Do not create new initiative-attack anchors from pure final-sprint overtakes after the race has clearly transitioned to terminal sprint/overtake behavior.

visual_sampling.cadence_purpose: Human review aid only; no automated tactical inference.
visual_sampling.minimum_visibility: If the 1-second sample is insufficient, label UNKNOWN rather than infer absence.

numeric_reporting.small_sample_rule: Never convert a small-sample pilot estimate into a single Reality truth coefficient.
numeric_reporting.no_cross_event_substitution: A BANTE_FOLLOW conditional rate cannot stand in for line cohesion, fragmentation, switching, or finish effect.

terminal_rule: After this protocol, the expansion sample may be reviewed for conditional BANTE_FOLLOW and INITIATIVE_CONFLICT pilot diagnostics only. No absolute tactic rate, causal finish effect, model selection, finish-truth generation, or real predictive claim is authorized.
